title: A Physics-Informed Neural Network Framework for Elastodynamic Wave Propagation in Bimaterial Systems
summary: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) provide a promising framework for solving partial differential equations while embedding the underlying physical laws directly into the learning process. This study presents a PINN-based framework for modeling transient elastodynamic wave propagation in bimaterial systems governed by the axisymmetric equations of linear elasticity.
